term: present support, concrete supporters and an underived root, for the selected relation
definition: NecessarySupportIsPresent m w: whatever supports a being necessary from w, at any world where that supporter exists, also exists at w and supports it at w. ActualSupportersConcrete m w: an existing supporter of an actual concretum at w is concrete. UnderivedRootAt m w x: x is an actual root of the restricted relation at w, necessary from w, and has no existing supporter at any world. All three take the profile's selected relation m.grounds as the supportsEsse parameter of NecessarilyUnderived.
note: Analyst's vocabulary for #487, with no source. Ordinary meaning: a thing that exists in every accessible world does not owe its existence to something that is absent here or to a dependence that does not hold here; and a concrete thing's existing supporters here are themselves concrete. Examples: UnderivedRouteControls has finite models satisfying both (limitsProfile). Counterexamples: rotating, where two necessary concreta support each other at different worlds; possibleContingent, where the supporter is absent from w; abstractSupport, where an abstract individual supports the only concretum. They differ from NecessaryPredecessorLifting, which also makes the supporter necessary (WeakerThanLifting), from whole-carrier well-foundedness, and from any claim about efficient causation, explanation or transmission of power. No transitivity is assumed; the structural property, well-foundedness, is a separate open hypothesis restricted to actual concreta, and it does not reach abstract supporters. No generalization from experience is offered. OPEN: no real relation has been shown to satisfy either premise. A rival that takes necessary existence to be compatible with world-varying derivation, or abstract grounds of concreta to be genuine, denies them, and nothing here answers that rival. A sourced account of grounds (#545) would replace the stipulation.
